metadata.description: SwarmCloud's own tooling, for operators and agents working with a SwarmCloud deployment.

plugins.name: sc
plugins.description: SwarmCloud from inside a Claude Code session: read the cluster with the `sc` skill and /sc command, run this session's work out there with the `delegate` skill. Its MCP server is the swarm-mcp bridge, started with uv. At install it asks for YOUR deployment's URL and, for a deployment behind IAP, its Desktop OAuth client, then `sc login` signs you in as yourself.
